time_basis: Local timestamp strings as written by Corona; UTC offset not inferred
interpretation: Repeated restarts prevent refinement. No event-level trace establishes the initiating plugin/callback. Production rendering is a separately recorded result.

focused_ir_failure_window.basis: Recount of the inclusive timestamp window in the fuller current log; matches the earlier conversation observation.

whole_log_scope_note: Whole-session totals include later multi-pass rendering. They are not a count of proven IR failures; the initiating callback remains unisolated.
